    SELECT [c].[Id], [c].[BienId], [c].[DateCreation], [c].[DateDebut], [c].[DateFin], [c].[DateSuppression], [c].[DelaiJoursTolerance], [c].[EstSupprime], [c].[FrequencePaiement], [c].[LocataireId], [c].[MontantCaution], [c].[MontantLoyer], [c].[Statut], [u2].[Id] AS [Id0], [u2].[DateCreation] AS [DateCreation0], [u2].[DateSuppression] AS [DateSuppression0], [u2].[DerniereConnexion], [u2].[Email], [u2].[EstSupprime] AS [EstSupprime0], [u2].[MotDePasseHash], [u2].[Nom], [u2].[OtpExpiration], [u2].[OtpSecret], [u2].[Prenom], [u2].[Role], [u2].[Statut] AS [Statut0], [u2].[Telephone], [u2].[TelephoneVerifie], [u2].[TentativesConnexionEchouees], [u2].[VerrouilleJusquA]
    FROM [Contrats] AS [c]
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT [u1].[Id], [u1].[DateCreation], [u1].[DateSuppression], [u1].[DerniereConnexion], [u1].[Email], [u1].[EstSupprime], [u1].[MotDePasseHash], [u1].[Nom], [u1].[OtpExpiration], [u1].[OtpSecret], [u1].[Prenom], [u1].[Role], [u1].[Statut], [u1].[Telephone], [u1].[TelephoneVerifie], [u1].[TentativesConnexionEchouees], [u1].[VerrouilleJusquA]
        FROM [Utilisateurs] AS [u1]
        WHERE [u1].[EstSupprime] = CAST(0 AS bit)
    ) AS [u2] ON [c].[LocataireId] = [u2].[Id]
    WHERE [c].[EstSupprime] = CAST(0 AS bit)
) AS [s] ON [b].[Id] = [s].[BienId]
WHERE [b].[EstSupprime] = CAST(0 AS bit)
ORDER BY [b].[Id], [u0].[Id], [s].[Id]
